dataset: BBBC039v1 official training and validation partitions only
model: EfficientNet-B7/UNet++/SCSE with the original learned 4-to-3 projection
loss: 0.5 samplewise Dice + 0.5 BCE for every condition
schedule: 20-epoch cosine decay to 1% of initial learning rate; no early stopping
augmentation: uniform rotations by multiples of 90 degrees and horizontal flip with probability 0.5
precision: bfloat16 autocast with float32 loss and finite gradient checks
selection: highest native-grid mean Dice among foreground-containing validation images; the empty stratum is reported separately and every validation image is retained
primary_endpoint: foreground-containing validation mean Dice; empty-reference false positives reported separately; descriptive comparison across three seeds
status: Exploratory sensitivity study frozen before execution. Test cases are not decoded or evaluated; the archives are hashed only for dataset identity. This study cannot provide independent confirmation because BBBC039 was used in prior development.
